claims.quote: This cuboidal cell is thicker than squamous alveolar cells, has a rounded apical surface that projects above the level of the surrounding epithelium
its free surface is covered by short microvilli
secreting and recycling surfactants via specialized organelles called alveolar lamellar bodies

claims.value: Its lamellar bodies let it secrete and recycle surfactant, which is how it modulates the fluid around the alveolar epithelium.
claims.quote: A pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell that modulates the fluid surrounding the alveolar epithelium by secreting and recycling surfactants via specialized organelles called alveolar lamellar bodies.

claims.value: Scattered among the type I cells, it secretes pulmonary surfactant, a mix of phospholipids and proteins that lowers surface tension in the alveoli.
claims.quote: A type II alveolar cell is interspersed among the type I cells and secretes pulmonary surfactant, a substance composed of phospholipids and proteins that reduces the surface tension of the alveoli.

claims.value: The surfactant it secretes reduces surface tension, which keeps the alveoli from collapsing during expiration.
claims.quote: However, pulmonary surfactant secreted by type II alveolar cells mixes with that water and helps reduce this surface tension. Without pulmonary surfactant, the alveoli would collapse during expiration.

claims.value: It also takes part in tissue repair, and after injury it can differentiate into a type 1 alveolar cell.
claims.quote: This cell type also contributes to tissue repair and can differentiate after injury into a pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell.

tier1.text: A pulmonary alveolar epithelial cell that modulates the fluid surrounding the alveolar epithelium by secreting and recycling surfactants via specialized organelles called alveolar lamellar bodies. This cell type also contributes to tissue repair and can differentiate after injury into a pulmonary alveolar type 1 cell. This cuboidal cell is thicker than squamous alveolar cells, has a rounded apical surface that projects above the level of the surrounding epithelium, and its free surface is covered by short microvilli.
